name: Amahashi Yukiya
source:
Part of unit Re:Fly

A calm person in appearance, but everything about him is shrouded in mystery.
Other students refer to him as "Cosmo" and seem to idolize him...?
When asked about his dream for the future, he responded with "invading Earth". He appears to have a connection with Areki Sae.
